title: Extracellular peroxiredoxin 6 released from alveolar epithelial cells as a DAMP drives macrophage activation and inflammatory exacerbation in acute lung injury.
authors: Lang, Ke; Wang, Xiaocen; Wei, Tingting; Ning, Xinyi; Chen, Shuyang; Luo, Yuqiao; Li, Hongru; Xu, Yifan; Yang, Dong; Song, Yuanlin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肺泡上皮释放的PRDX6作为DAMP激活巨噬细胞炎症，虽用分子对接验证PRDX6-MD2互作，但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA，方法仅简单对接，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is featured with acute lung inflammatory injury. Our prospective study found that higher levels of peroxiredoxin 6(PRDX6) were detected in bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) fluid from ARDS patients. Elevated PRDX6 was also correlated with monocytic activation and poor prognosis in ARDS patients. To investigate the origin of extracellular PRDX6, we conducted in vitro and in vivo experiments, demonstrating that PRDX6 can be actively released from alveolar epithelial cells under stress conditions. Our study demonstrated that it could be released from injured lung epithelial cells into the bronchoalveolar interstitial space in mice with acute lung injury and in vitro experiments. Moreover, exogenous PRDX6 was shown to activate the TLR4/NF-kappaB signalling pathway and induce M1 polarization of macrophages. Notably, the inflammatory effects of PRDX6 were mitigated by specific inhibition of the TLR4 (Toll-like receptor 4)-MD2 (Myeloid differentiation factor 2) complex. Using molecular docking simulations and in vitro binding assays, we confirmed a direct interaction between PRDX6 and MD2, further supporting its role as a damage-associated molecular patterns (DAMP) in ARDS. Our findings suggest that extracellular PRDX6 in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid could be a new DAMP factor in ALI, providing new insights into the pathogenesis of secondary hit in ALI/ARDS and highlighting PRDX6 as a potential therapeutic target for mitigating lung inflammation.
abstract_zh: 急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）以急性肺部炎症损伤为特征。我们的前瞻性研究发现，在ARDS患者的支气管肺泡灌洗（BAL）液中检测到较高水平的过氧化物还原酶6（PRDX6）。升高的PRDX6还与ARDS患者的单核细胞活化及不良预后相关。为探究细胞外PRDX6的来源，我们进行了体外和体内实验，证明PRDX6可在应激条件下由肺泡上皮细胞主动释放。我们的研究表明，在急性肺损伤小鼠及体外实验中，PRDX6可从受损的肺上皮细胞释放至支气管肺泡间质空间。此外，外源性PRDX6被证明可激活TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路并诱导巨噬细胞M1极化。值得注意的是，通过特异性抑制TLR4（Toll样受体4）-MD2（髓样分化因子2）复合物，PRDX6的炎症效应得以减轻。利用分子对接模拟和体外结合实验，我们确认了PRDX6与MD2之间的直接相互作用，进一步支持其作为ARDS中损伤相关分子模式（DAMP）的作用。我们的研究结果表明，支气管肺泡灌洗液中的细胞外PRDX6可能是ALI中的一种新型DAMP因子，为ALI/ARDS中二次打击的发病机制提供了新见解，并强调PRDX6是减轻肺部炎症的潜在治疗靶点。
